_note: Korean labels for the bank-72 button plates. Plate indices come from out/title_menu_capture/bank72_atlas.json. Each plate is 80x16 packed 4bpp; glyphs are rendered with Galmuri11Bitmap Regular at native 16 px (the ending-credit face) so ㅖ in 계속 keeps a 1 px gap. Advance = glyph width + 1, so a plate holds about 6 syllables. 'drawn_at_boot' is the plate the initial menu actually draws (measured by zeroing one plate at a time); labels that never appear on the initial menu omit it.

labels._reading: first glyph is 金-left with a 皿 base, second is ⺌ over 貝 -> 鑑賞
